title: turraea humilis
intro: Turraea humilis, commonly known as the African dogwood, is a plant species in the family Meliaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Turraea humilis also exhibit antidiabetic and anticancer properties, making it a potential source of natural remedies for various health conditions.
